messages.content: Return only a complete dependency-free Rust test source file, no Markdown fences and no prose. The file must begin exactly with `mod candidate { include!("repair1.rs"); }`. The exact signatures are `candidate::norm_bounds(f64, f64) -> Result<(f64, f64), candidate::BoundError>` and `candidate::relative_peak_bounds(f64, f64, f64) -> Result<(f64, f64), candidate::BoundError>`. Import and compare the Result and BoundError values correctly. Define independent outer #[test] functions. Required black-box tests: sharp reverse triangle (1,3)->Ok((2,4)); equal norms; finite MAX+1 remains Ok where IEEE rounding keeps upper finite; exact MAX+MAX gives Err(Overflow); NaN, positive infinity, negative infinity and negatives yield the documented errors; relative P0=1,Dpeak=3,floor=1 returns Ok((0,4)), contains P1=1.1, and P1<abs(1-3)=2; floor zero, negative zero, negative, NaN and infinities reject; MAX/MIN_POSITIVE gives Err(Overflow); relative MAX+MAX gives Err(Overflow); add one ordinary non-unit-floor case. Explicitly annotate ambiguous floats as f64. Do not reproduce or alter implementation. Do not use external crates.
